sourceReviewMethod: Exact immutable source payload hashes checked before acceptance using the existing review_map_change transaction and its source revision guards. The university category used the authenticated field-review UI. Preview and publication use the normal owner release workflow.

New footprints remain unnamed; no heights, tenants, entrances, walking connections or vehicle permissions are inferred.
